entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey, is everyone else locked up in this[n]place as well?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Then it could be that they're all in the[n]same state I was earlier...
entries.uk: Тоді, можливо, вони всі в такому[n]самому стані, як я щойно...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Joker, there don't seem to be any[n]Shadows around here. I'll wait[n]somewhere nearby.
entries.uk: Джокере, Тіней тут начебто[n]нема. Я почекаю десь[n]поблизу.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In the meantime, I ask that you save[n]everyone else. I'm sure they need your[n]help more than anything.
entries.uk: А тим часом прошу тебе врятувати[n]решту. Я певна, твоя допомога їм[n]зараз потрібна понад усе.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And, um... I think it would be best you[n]go alone.
entries.uk: І, ем... гадаю, найкраще[n]тобі піти самому.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I'm here... and you are as well.[n]I expect the others would be somewhere[n]around too.
entries.uk: Але я тут... і ти теж.[n]Гадаю, решта теж десь[n]поруч.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey, is everyone else locked up in this[n]place as well?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Okay, I'll wait here. I ask that you go save[n]the others.
entries.uk: Гаразд, я почекаю тут. Прошу тебе,[n]іди врятуй решту.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's no doubt they're in need of your[n]help...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The others must surely be waiting for you.[n]Please hurry up and find them soon.
entries.uk: Решта, напевно, чекають на тебе.[n]Будь ласка, поквапся їх знайти.
